policy.scope: All npm packages recorded in package-lock.json, including dev and optional dependencies. Workspace packages are excluded because they are first-party code.
policy.sourceOfTruth: package-lock.json; the generated CycloneDX SBOM retains the same license values
policy.reviewCadence: Every dependency PR and at least quarterly
policy.note: Allowed licences are permissive or public-domain equivalents. Review-required licences are not forbidden, but each package family needs a named owner, reason, review date and conditions. Denied licences block the build; critical policy changes require a documented architecture decision.

approvals.reason: Optional native image codecs shipped only as separate platform packages for the non-production web shell.
approvals.conditions: Keep these packages optional; do not statically link or redistribute modified codecs without counsel review.

approvals.reason: CSS transformer used only by the non-production web shell; source-availability obligations are documented in the SBOM.
approvals.conditions: Do not promote the web shell to production without a redistribute/modification review.

approvals.reason: Browser compatibility data; no Vintora content is derived from it.
approvals.conditions: Retain attribution in dependency metadata; do not republish the dataset as first-party content.

approvals.reason: Legacy transitive packages whose manifests omit a machine-readable SPDX licence; upstream sources were reviewed during Phase 1.
approvals.conditions: Replace or remove before promoting the dependent surface to production; re-review on every version change.

approvals.reason: The package declares BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0; the permissive BSD alternative is selected for use.
approvals.conditions: Do not change the selected licence alternative; re-review if the SPDX expression changes.
